g.title: cluster_agent
g.text: Storyteller Agent (gpt-3.5-turbo, tool calling, one conversation)

g.title: cluster_room
g.text: Writers' room (gpt-3.5 specialists, after Agents' Room, ICLR 2025)

g.title: user
g.text: name · age 5-10 · something from today · a shelf (Surprise me, 11 genres, My own idea)

g.title: guard
g.text: clean text · real names only · injection check

g.title: screen
g.text: Safety screen (1 LLM call, only for "My own idea")

g.title: steps
g.text: The book's cover shows each step

g.title: plan
g.text: planning specialists on a shared scratchpad

g.title: auto
g.text: seeds → pitch → room → write → review → fit → rehearse

g.title: listener
g.text: Young listener (gpt-3.5 as a child of this age)
sees only the pitches → picks one + why

g.title: memory
g.text: recent names & ideas · each child's stories (sequels)

g.title: ideas
g.text: Premise bank · space facts · comic scenes
88 hand-written seeds: a want, a funny obstacle, a twist

g.title: room
g.text: each part checked in code (age rules · seed kept · twist lands)

g.title: writer
g.text: Section writers: opening · build-up · big moment · wind-down · sleepy ending
read the scratchpad · the example as their own earlier story (+ a comic scene)
action → 4+ lines of talk → close the moment · checked, retried, best kept

g.title: checks
g.text: words 500-800 · safety words · repeats · copying the example
overused words · hard words · habits · passive · talking

g.title: judge
g.text: safety veto · yes/no checklist → score in code

g.title: rails
g.text: listener first · no writing before the plan passes · soft gates pass on the 2nd try
judge skipped while length is wrong · best draft = safe, judged, in range · finish refused unless safe, in range,
no copy/repeat, reviewed, rehearsed, passing · stuck after 4 refusals

g.title: editor
g.text: reads the plot: cause → effect, quirk solves it,
twist lands, joke returns → one plot redo
